search_text: published ZDI-16-076 ZDI-CAN-3225 Advantech WebAccess webvrpcs Service ViewSrv.dll strcpy Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-02-05 CVE-2016-0856 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-0856 9.3 ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable instances of Advantech WebAccess. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the 0x2789 IOCTL in the ViewSrv subsystem. A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in a call to strcpy. An attacker can use this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of an administrator of the system. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
